name: Stop-relay rocker 3R: J1 on a spring-centred acromial rocker that moves only once J2 is on a hard stop
lens: round4: move the fold boundary with a determined element (honest singular pass / detent)
family: scheduled 4th axis: spherical 3R + passive base rocker (force-closed by stops and a centring spring)
verdict: in progress: first measurements (local + 256-config farm coarse): best 35.24 fast (leader spine-parked 28.49 fast at k7008, CMA-B 30.24); CMA-ES streams running on the farm
limiter: pending CMA: the gained (mode B/C) poses put hub 2 / hub 0 over high skin (raised arm) and the pivot hub collides with link 1 in mode A

mechanism.notes: spine-parked spherical 3R with J1 carried by a passive rocker R0 (pivot axis through GH). bodies: rocker, link 1, link 2, arm-end (member 3: hub-3 plate + K7 neck rigid on BOTTOM). joints: R0 (O15 slim hub, MR117-2RS pair, AS5600 + magnet: SENSED, the rocker angle must be read in modes B/C to know the arm pose), J1 (O20), J2 (O15, with an O2 dowel in a 103-deg arc slot = its two hard stops), J3 (O15). Centring: ONE centring element (a double-torsion spring, or a V-cam + spring-plunger detent) counted as 1 spring; two opposed single torsion springs would count 2. Open chain closed by GH: Kutzbach M = 4 with the spring + stops determining q0 (force closure, R17 checked in the doc). custom: base, rocker, 2 links, arm-end plate + neck, 4 hub shafts (9, est.); catalogue: 4 x MR117 pair, 1 spring (or plunger), J2 stop dowel + 2 PEEK pads (est. 8; sensor parts not counted).
